name.en: Yā Banī l-Muṣṭafā - O Sons of the Chosen One

ara: قَدْ سَمَا فَضْلُكُمْ يَا بَنِي الزَّهْرَا
قَدْ صَفَا عَيْشُنَا يَا مُدِيرَ الرَّاحْ
صَلِّ يَا رَبَّنَا مَا حَدَا الْحَادِي
en: yā bani l-muṣṭafā antumu dhukhrī
fa-rḥamū ʿabdakum wa-jburū kasrī
jiʾtukum rājiyan bi-abī bakri
wa-bi-man ʿadluhu shamlu l-akwān
wa-ʿaliyyi l-murtaḍā wa-sh-shahīdi ʿuthmān
qad samā faḍlukum yā bani z-zahrā
wa-ʿalā shaʾnukum fi l-warā ṭurrā
ḥuztumū sādatī fi l-ʿulā qadrā
jaddukum khayru man sharrafa l-akwān
aḥmadu l-muṣṭafā min bani l-ʿadnān
qad ṣafā ʿayshunā yā mudīra r-rāḥ
qum binā musriʿan wa-mlaʾi l-aqdāḥ
wa-sqinā shurbatan tunʿishu l-arwāḥ
khamrata l-ḥubbi kay tanjali l-aḥzān
naḥtasī shurbahā min yadi r-raḥmān
wāṣilū ḥubbakum yā dhawi l-qadri
wa-mnaḥū ʿaṭfakum wa-hjurū hijrī
dhubtu fī ḥubbikum wa-faniya ṣabrī
fa-l-jafā fi l-ḥashā yulhibu n-nīrān
fa-ṣilū mughraman yā dhawi l-ʿirfān
ṣalli yā rabbanā mā ḥada l-ḥādī
ʿalā man sharrafa n-nādī wa-l-wādī
wa-ʿala l-āli hum ʿitratu l-hādī
wa-ʿala ṣ-ṣaḥbi man ayyadu l-qurʾān
wa-ʿala t-tābiʿīna nāṣiri d-diyān
O children of the Chosen One, you are my treasure,
have mercy upon your servant, heal my broken state.
I have come to implore by Abu Bakr,
and the one whose justice encompasses all existing,
and ʿAli, with whom Allah is well pleased, and the martyr ʿUthman.
Foremost is your virtue, O sons of al-Zahra,
and your rank is above every human rank.
O my masters, you have attained the utmost elevation,
your grandfather was the best whose presence honoured the universe:
Ahmad, the Chosen One, from the Banu ʿAdnan.
Our lives are now serene, O master of the wine,
see to us, hurry, and fill our cups!
Pour us a drink that will quench the thirst of our souls,
from the wine of love that dispels the sorrows,
that we may sip its drink from the hand of the All-Merciful.
Unite (us with) your love, O you owners of rank,
grant the gift of your affection, break my separation!
I have melted in love for you, and my patience is dissolved,
the estrangement within me kindles fires.
Unite the yearning one, O you endowed with ʿirfan (gnosis)!
Send blessings, O our Lord, as long as the caravan driver sings to spur his camels,
upon the one whose presence honoured this gathering and this valley,
and upon the Family, who are the offspring of the Guide,
and the Companions, who supported the Quran,
and the ones who followed them, supporting the Din.
